blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Dinaro's EURGH white paper permits individual and global freezes and recall of issued EURGH. On November 8 2026, XRPL account_info for rDdaSjBbgCGQQsGRSfMidBMyHbPoeE5KQR at validated ledger 108194664 returned Flags 2156527616, allowTrustLineClawback=true, noFreeze=false and globalFreeze=false. Clawback is enabled and freeze capability has not been irrevocably disabled; no global freeze was active at that ledger. gateway_balances at the same ledger reported obligations for the announcement's EURGH currency code 4555524748000000000000000000000000000000, and account_lines at validated ledger 108194675 showed outstanding holder trust-line balances. This is direct holder-control evidence on XRPL. Xahau issuance and account flags were not independently read, so the XRPL observation is not asserted for Xahau.
